description: Recursively removes empty folders under a chosen root folder.

fields.name: TargetFolder
fields.label: Folder to scan
fields.helpText: The root folder whose empty subfolders will be removed.
fields.helpDetail: Only folders with no files and no non-empty subfolders are removed. This runs repeatedly to catch parents that become empty. The root folder itself is never removed, even if it is empty. Empty folders are deleted permanently, but they contain no data to recover.
